context: A tweet in Swedish, posted between April 2013 and February 2015 and collected through the Twitter Search API near the largest cities where the language is spoken. A native speaker labelled each tweet by the emotional attitude of the person who posted it.
answer: {"question":"What emotional attitude does the poster of this Swedish tweet express or imply: positive, neutral, or negative?","rule":"Judge the poster's own attitude, including attitude shown through what they choose to share. Retweets of bad news, criticism, complaints or troubling topics (accidents, layoffs, political attacks, deaths) are negative even when they sound factual. Friendly, helpful, joking or approving replies are positive even when mild.
